coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 9 ground-truth variable categories (22%): the three target properties (p-logP, QED, and binding affinity) and structural diversity, including long-carbon-chain measurements. Other categories are absent or materially different.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits the fixed MOLGEN pipeline scripts and DeepSpeed configuration. Replaces ESR1/ACAA1 with unrelated protein targets and substitutes architectural and feedback comparisons for the specified pretrained, chemical-feedback-finetuned, and baseline configurations. Does not vary synthetic versus natural-product datasets, report top-three property scores, or measure the specified ESR1/ACAA1 affinity improvements. Its physiological p-logP objective also differs from the intended high-score optimization.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides no conclusion about MOLGEN's high p-logP scores, maintained or improved QED, lower KD values, approximately 96.7% and 70.4% affinity improvements for ESR1 and ACAA1, reduced molecular hallucinations, or preserved diversity.
